text:
Every host has a 2 AM guest.

What's the latest a guest has messaged you, and what did they actually want?

Guest: "Wi-Fi password?"

The Wi-Fi password: on the fridge, in the welcome message, on the router, in the listing.

Guest, 20 minutes later: "Wi-Fi password?"

We've all had this guest.

Which guest message do you dread more?

A) "Can we check in at 6 AM?"
B) "Can we check out at 6 PM?"

Things a guest should never wait 2 hours for:

· the check-in address
· the Wi-Fi password
· an answer to "is parking there?"

Bella answers guests on WhatsApp in about 3 seconds, day or night. You don't have to.

"Bhaiya, sirf 2 log hain."

*15 log gaadi se utarte hain*

Hosts, what's your record for extra guests who weren't on the booking?

Unpopular opinion: pricing Diwali weekend like a normal Saturday is the costliest mistake a host can make.

Agree or disagree?

A property manager takes a cut of every booking. Bella takes 0%.

She replies to your guests, sets nightly prices for weekends and festivals, and blocks your calendar so nothing double-books. You stay in charge of your own place.

Want a look? DM @redflag.homes on Instagram.
Hosting is 10% making the place look good and 90% answering "is there parking?"
Hosts, one word only: what do guests always forget to ask until they've already arrived?

One guest writes in English. The next one in Hinglish. The one after that, in a language you don't speak at all.

Bella replies in 50+ languages, in about 3 seconds, on WhatsApp. You get to sleep.

Some guests leave a 5-star review and also take every single hanger.

Hosts, what's the strangest thing a guest has walked off with?

What Bella does for a host, in one post:

1. Replies to guests in about 3 seconds, 24/7
2. Sets nightly prices for weekends, festivals and demand
3. Sends check-in details
4. Blocks the calendar so nothing double-books
5. Talks to bnb support for you

All on WhatsApp, with 0% commission. Basically the stuff you'd do at 2 AM, except you're asleep.
Long weekend coming up. Do you raise your price, keep it the same, or wait to see if it books first?
